model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different model variants. The x-axis represents the number of completions (*k*), displayed on a logarithmic (base-2) scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick labels at each power of two. The y-axis represents coverage on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.40 to 0.90. Four lines are shown, each corresponding to a different model configuration. The dark blue line with filled circle markers (Llama-3B) starts at approximately 0.43 at k = 1 and increases steadily, reaching approximately 0.90 at k = 256. The green dashed line with filled square markers (Llama-3B + FT) starts at approximately 0.47 at k = 1 and rises to approximately 0.90 at k = 256, closely tracking the Llama-3B line but starting slightly higher and converging at larger k values. The light blue line with open circle markers (Llama-1B) starts at approximately 0.42 at k = 1 and increases to approximately 0.88 at k = 256, generally running slightly below the Llama-3B lines. The light green line with open triangle markers (Llama-1B + FT) starts at approximately 0.45 at k = 1 and rises to approximately 0.88 at k = 256, tracking slightly above the Llama-1B line at lower k values. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend that decelerates at higher values of k, with the curves appearing to plateau as they approach k = 256.
